newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa CityLine appoints new chief exec.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa CityLine appoints new chief exec.

text.p: Lufthansa CityLine, the regional carrier subsidiary of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said Karl-Heinz Koepfle has been appoined managing director.
He replaces Karl-Friedrich Rausch who will be responsible for product and services for the new Lufthansa passenger division from April 1, a statement said.

Koepfle has been Lufthansa senior vice president grounds operations since 1992 and was previously a board member of Lufthansa's German Cargo services subsidiary. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
